scene.ko: 박물관 전시실에서 해설사의 짧은 설명을 듣고, 오래된 그릇이 언제 어떻게 쓰였는지 묻는다.

lines.en: This bowl is one of the oldest pieces in our collection.
lines.ko: 이 그릇은 저희 소장품 가운데 가장 오래된 것 중 하나예요.

lines.en: It's about three thousand years old. It was found near a river in the south.
lines.ko: 3천 년쯤 됐어요. 남쪽의 한 강 근처에서 발견됐어요.

lines.en: That's amazing. What was it used for?
alt: Amazing. What did people use it for?

lines.en: People stored grain in it. You can see their finger marks on the side.
lines.ko: 사람들이 곡식을 담아 두었어요. 옆면에 손가락 자국이 보이실 거예요.

lines.en: Oh, I can see them now. Did people back then make everything by hand?
lines.ko: 아, 이제 보여요. 그때 사람들은 뭐든지 손으로 만들었나요?
alt: Oh, I see them. Was everything made by hand back then?

lines.en: Yes. The potter's wheel came much later. There's a display about it in the next room.
lines.ko: 네. 물레는 훨씬 나중에 나왔어요. 다음 전시실에 물레에 관한 전시가 있어요.

lines.en: Thanks for explaining. I'll go check it out.
alt: Thank you for the explanation. I'll take a look.
